name: Patrick's To-Do List
aka: Patrick To Do List Actually Blank
look: A SpongeBob SquarePants close-up of Patrick's pink hands: one grips a sheet of pale blue paper while the other holds a yellow pencil to it. "TO-DO LIST" is handwritten and underlined across the top, and the rest of the page is empty.
use: The empty page gets filled with someone's to-do list, usually one lazy, absurd or brutally honest item that sums up their real priorities, or a list that undercuts the whole idea of being productive.
slots: the items written on the list
examples: 1. Wake up 2. Nap 3. Recover from the nap
Buy a planner so I can start making to-do lists
describe: patrick star writing on a blank list with a pencil
pink cartoon hand holding paper that says to do list
starfish hands with an empty checklist and a pencil
spongebob scene of someone about to write down their plans
handwritten to do list paper with nothing on it yet
origin: A close-up from the animated series SpongeBob SquarePants.
